description:
# Boutique Luxury Hotels & Experiential Resorts Across India
A collection of heartwarming boutique stays across India - restored palaces, wilderness retreats and tea estates, rooted in the soul of each destination.

The cuisine, infused with flavors from our Natural Herb & Spice garden, offers a delightful fusion of Kumaoni specialties with Indian and international palates in mind. Rooms here come with sit-out decks and balconies, offering vistas of lush flora and the soothing whispers of mountain breezes.

Within easy reach of Jaipur and Delhi, Brij Bageecha is a pet-friendly retreat featuring 20 private villas across an 11-acre garden setting filled with greenery and water bodies. Each villa offers a private courtyard, while select villas feature private heated plunge pools.Explore the organic farm and discover Rajasthan-inspired experiences, including pottery, puppet shows, lac bangle making, archery, village tours, camel rides and visits to Jaipur’s forts, palaces and cottage industries.

Each detail, from the historic water catchment to the hand-carved pool perched atop a rock hill, whispers tales of tranquillity and grandeur.

Surrounded by a serene forest residential area, this idyllic home offers the perfect balance of tranquility and excitement. Immerse yourself in the local culture, explore nearby beaches, and savor delicious Goan cuisine.

Here, you can explore wildlife, embark on treks, visit ancient temples, and immerse yourself in its breathtaking beauty. Known for its national park, teeming with panthers, hyenas, bears, wolves and crocodiles, Jawai is also a haven for over 100 species of migratory birds. It is especially renowned for its human-friendly leopards.

With just seventeen villas, cottages, and residences spread across nine acres, Brij Tara is designed for those who value privacy, quiet moments, and meaningful experiences.

Perched atop one of Moti Tiba's highest peaks, amidst dense Deodar forests, lies our exquisite retreat—an oasis for family travelers, seniors, and honeymooners alike. Our spacious and tastefully appointed rooms, adorned with colonial-era decor and exquisite artworks, offer unparalleled comfort. Whether you choose our Imperial Rooms or Classic Rooms, each is designed to provide utmost convenience and luxury. Our culinary offerings, crafted with authentic ingredients and served with flair, promise a gastronomic journey that delights both heart and soul.

Architecture, landscape and local traditions are held in careful balance, creating a stay that feels intimate, grounded and deeply connected to its surroundings.

## Experiences
Nestled at the base of the iconic Amber Palace and Fort near Jaipur, Hathi Gaon, or the Elephant Village, offers a unique sanctuary for over 100 elephants and their devoted Mahouts. Witness the daily bathing rituals, where these gentle giants enjoy a refreshing dip, playfully splashing in the water.

Immerse yourself in the rich culinary heritage of Goa by learning to make traditional dry spice mixes like Xacuti or Recheado under the guidance of our expert chefs. Discover the secrets behind perfectly balanced flavors as you grind and blend fragrant spices, transforming simple ingredients into aromatic masalas.

Explore the tranquil Aravalli Hills with visits to the sacred temples of Jawai. Here, you can bask in the peaceful ambiance and enjoy the beauty of the hills.

Kids and adults alike will love our recreation room and garden, the perfect setting to bond over board games or let imaginations run wild. Children can indulge in coloring, PS5 gaming, painting shells and pebbles, or experimenting with leaf imprinting—all in a cozy indoor environment. Step outside to our sand pit for even more fun under the sun, from building sandcastles to simply soaking in the outdoors.

## Where hospitality feels like home
Rooted in India’s living heritage and shaped by nature, our retreats are designed for those who seek meaning beyond the ordinary.
